7473.title: Retry supersession repeatedly scans request history
7473.rootCauseOneLine: A correlated acceptance lookup repeatedly JSON-scans request history inside synchronous retry supersession.
7473.proposedFix: Use uncorrelated membership in eligible root/direct-retry request IDs, preserving queue semantics.
7473.caveats: Synthetic database/API reproduction only; historical 207-second production incident and HTTP/UI latency not verified. Second clean run performed by the same agent. All-workspace build hit an unrelated SDK runtime build-order error; relevant tests and static checks pass.
